summary.text: Wei Ling Yang is a Heavenly Court Gu Immortal who activates a killer move that seals Spring Autumn Cicada so it cannot activate for three months.

claims.text: He is the third Gu Immortal in the hall with Fairy Zi Wei and Myriad Tidal Dragon. His voice is hoarse. He has a middle aged appearance, dark bags under his eyes, and a listless look of extreme fatigue. Fairy Zi Wei and Myriad Tidal Dragon treat his move as enough to set Spring Autumn Cicada aside. Myriad Tidal Dragon names him Wei Ling Yang.
Fang Yuan’s account names him a rank eight restriction path Gu Immortal of Heavenly Court, and says the seal on Spring Autumn Cicada seemed to have worn out not long before that chapter.

He walks out of his hall when Heavenly Court trembles, then goes with Granny Sha to Fairy Zi Wei. He says the immortal graveyard is unfathomable, and that anyone who woke Heavenly Court with such tremors must be extraordinary. None of his own methods work on the withered old man in the pit. He warns that the senior’s life force is dwindling and that without a cure the man will die in minutes. Granny Sha then feeds the man true dragon heavenly water, and Fairy Zi Wei names him Duke Long.

At the crucial moment he decides to charge ahead with Edge Link Camp and tells the rest to follow. The three Immortal Gu Houses enter the star cloud storm. Myriad Tidal Dragon is sleeping. After Wind Sweeping Building is knocked away, his call to Bi Chen Tian breaks up. He cannot stay behind or reinforce Bi Chen Tian, because Canary Pavilion around him also needs to be taken care of.

He leads Canary Pavilion through the star cloud storm with difficulty. They leave the storm after Bi Chen Tian and are ambushed by a sky chief beast group. Canary Pavilion and Edge Link Camp are both at the ambush, surrounded and heavily damaged. After communication resumes, Wei Ling Yang moves Edge Link Camp towards Canary Pavilion, cooperating to break out. The three Immortal Gu Houses are heavily damaged, Myriad Tidal Dragon is unconscious, and Wei Ling Yang has spent more than half his immortal essence. Half the journey remains. He says they can only use spaceless tunnel. Bi Chen Tian agrees that this is the only way to cross half the remaining distance. Fairy Zi Wei had already prepared that method among other plans.

Leaving Bi Chen Tian to hold Edge Link Camp, Wei Ling Yang slips out alone to try each snowy peak, confident he can manage it because rule path gives him a great advantage there, one Old Ancestor Xue Hu, though stronger than him, cannot match.

During the Snowy Mountain blessed land assault, Old Ancestor Xue Hu freezes Wei Ling Yang’s right hand without Wei Ling Yang noticing the strike. Several methods fail to improve it and he settles for sealing the hand. By the time he charges out of Edge Link Camp again the injury is fully healed, which marks very high attainment in healing.

After Mu Ling Lan dies holding Old Ancestor Xue Hu back so Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun can escape, Wei Ling Yang calls out that Central Continent and Heavenly Court will remember the sacrifice and charges at Old Ancestor Xue Hu.

Once Old Ancestor Xue Hu withdraws from Reverse Flow River to save his unconscious wife, fifth place among those still swimming upstream passes to Heavenly Court’s rank eight rule path Gu Immortal Wei Ling Yang and the Central Continent Gu Immortals with him.

Of the Central Continent Gu Immortals, Wei Ling Yang alone lasts until only he, Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun, Ying Wu Xie’s group, and Fang Yuan remain in Reverse Flow River, but he too reaches his limit and is washed away against his will.

As Fang Yuan, known in Northern Plains as Liu Guan Yi, closes on Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun, Wei Ling Yang speaks for Central Continent’s ten great sects and for Heavenly Court, and offers him a place in Central Continent if he protects the pair, with his immortal aperture modified so that he can adapt to Central Continent’s heaven and earth qi.

News of the Northern Plains expedition says that of the three rank eight Gu Immortals Wei Ling Yang, Myriad Tidal Dragon, and Bi Chen Tian, two died and one went missing. Zhao Lian Yun, Yu Yi Ye Zi, Shi Zheng Yi, and the rest were saved by Wei Ling Yang risking his life, and escaped under Central Continent reinforcements. The same news names the killer of the rank eight Gu Immortals as Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s former steed, the legendary immemorial desolate beast dog tail life extending ferret.
Fang Yuan’s account names Wei Ling Yang and Bi Chen Tian as the two who died, with Myriad Tidal Dragon the one who escaped.

positions.position: Wei Ling Yang is a rank eight restriction path Gu Immortal of Heavenly Court.
Wei Ling Yang is a rule path Gu Immortal.
